summary: Comprehensive TruckTrust testing. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests PASS covering auth (register, login, duplicate, /auth/me, update profile), admin (login, stats, users/loads/bookings/disputes lists, verify-user, resolve-dispute), shipper (post load, my loads), driver (feed with truck_type filter), offers (create/counter/accept->booking with 8% platform fee), negotiation messages, bookings (pay-mock, OTP masking for driver, pickup OTP, delivery OTP, status stepper fields trip_status->in_transit->delivered), ratings (post-completion, double-rate prevention), disputes (create+resolve), RBAC (driver blocked from admin & /loads POST, shipper blocked from /loads GET). Frontend: Expo web preview loaded on mobile viewport; admin login redirects to /admin dashboard; tabs (Users/Loads/Bookings/Disputes) switch; shipper login + post-load form successfully creates a load and returns to home; driver login shows Available Loads feed with filter chip row. All critical onPress buttons (login, register, post-load-fab, post-submit, admin-logout, admin-tabs) are tappable via testIDs. React Native deprecation warnings detected: shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents (should migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents).

issues: Filter chip options are hardcoded truck types (Container, Open Body, Trailer, Tanker). The backend accepts arbitrary truck_type strings, but shipper post form chips must match driver filter chips exactly - verified both come from shared TRUCK_TYPES constant, so OK. No visible design defect.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated shadow* style props (shadowOpacity, shadowRadius, shadowOffset). React Native Web warns these are deprecated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:195. Migrate to boxShadow.
Uses deprecated shadow* style props. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/toast.tsx:70. Migrate to boxShadow.
Uses deprecated props.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/toast.tsx:50. Move pointerEvents into the style prop (style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}).
`useNativeDriver: true` falls back to JS animation on web (console warning). Low priority; acceptable for web preview but add Platform.OS check if targeting production web.

action_items: Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow in src/components/ui.tsx and src/components/toast.tsx to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Move pointerEvents="none" from props to style in src/components/toast.tsx (line 50).
(Optional) Guard useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' to avoid the native-animated warning on Expo Web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 670-line file. Consider splitting into routers (auth, loads, offers, bookings, admin) once feature set grows beyond MVP.
accept_offer in server.py (line 365) uses require_role('shipper') but still re-checks shipper_id ownership inside - good defensive coding, retain.
/api/bookings/{id}/pay (line 474) is a mock as declared. Clearly commented. OK for MVP.
No rate limiting on /auth/login - acceptable for MVP but worth noting for production.
MongoDB `_id` is correctly excluded via projection {"_id": 0} in all list/find endpoints and via .pop() in insert flows.
JWT uses HS256 with 30-day expiry - fine for MVP, consider refresh tokens later.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (core flows for 3 roles verified; offer->accept->OTP->rate->dispute flow covered end-to-end in backend tests, not re-exercised in UI due to scope)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create one TEST_ shipper and one TEST_ driver per run (random uuid-based emails) plus one load, one offer->accepted booking, one rating and one dispute. Data left in DB (no teardown) but uniquely namespaced per run_id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_trucktrust_api.py runs cleanly with `-n 0` (sequential; relies on module-level shared state dict). Email validation (pydantic EmailStr) rejects reserved TLDs like .test — use @example.com for test accounts. Admin seeded automatically on startup. Shipper endpoints: POST /loads, GET /loads/mine. Driver endpoints: GET /loads (?truck_type filter), POST /loads/{id}/offers. OTPs returned in accept-offer response and in GET /bookings/{id} for shipper, masked (None) for driver until each stage is verified. Full happy path verified end-to-end.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Initial pytest run showed 422 on /auth/register — root cause: pydantic EmailStr rejects synthetic '.test' TLD. Fixed by switching test emails to @example.com. Not a product bug.
